answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in sonnet, expire in jade, and zephyr lists each expiry. Someone running 53 aliases thus needs 64 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4381 identities would post 2950 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
